# garden/v6's module path. Deploy status is deliberately NOT recorded here -- see garden/v2's
# own gnomod.toml for why ("NOT deployed" written in this exact spot was deployed hours later
# and now lies on chain forever). For the live deploy status, read TESTNET.md -- not this file,
# which is a build input and cannot be trusted to describe the chain.
#
# WHAT v6 IS: garden/v5 plus exactly two fixes and nothing else -- (a) gnomes can be named
# (SetName, owner-only, after the roll, never during it), and (b) the drand round that produced
# each gnome is stored and readable (SettledRound). v5 is DEPLOYED AND LIVE on onyx and is
# immutable, which is why this is a new realm rather than a patch. Read garden.gno's "WHAT v6 IS"
# section before changing anything here: v5 survived a security audit and three real
# mutation-testing defect fixes, and every unrelated change to this file is a change that has
# not been audited.
#
# Checklist before ever deploying, full detail in garden.gno's package doc and gnomod.toml's
# git history. Items 0-6 are v5's own checklist, carried forward UNCHANGED because every one of
# them is still outstanding; 7-9 are new to v6.
#
#  (0) re-confirm the three sale constants, carried over from v4 as placeholders.
#  (1) adminAddress is the onyx deploy key `gnotchi-deploy`, which is also this namespace -- it
#      is funded (admin calls cost fees, and v4's old key is dust), but it is still a testnet key
#      whose mnemonic sits on this host, so change it for anywhere real.
#  (2) this realm imports the beacon/v2 drand verifier, from the OTHER namespace
#      (g1r4aw43...), exactly as v5 does -- that cross-namespace import works and must not be
#      "fixed". It cannot deploy where that path is not live.
#  (3) numEyes/numNoses/hat/coat catalogue must match the art side exactly.
#  (4) batchCap and the three named editions (hob/thistle/wick) are BATCH-ONE.md's roster,
#      re-read it. v6 adds a THIRD place those three names appear -- reservedNameKeys -- so a
#      roster change is now three edits, not two. TestReservedNamesCoverEveryNamedEdition pins
#      that they agree.
#  (5) lockCaredDays is the owner's RECOMMENDATION, not yet confirmed.
#  (6) genesisGnomeName is an unconfirmed placeholder. NEW IN v6 AND EASY TO MISS: it is no
#      longer read by nothing -- it is now the genesis gnome's actual on-chain name and its
#      canonical form must stay in reservedNameKeys, or an ordinary gnome could take it.
#      TestGenesisNameIsReserved fails if that pairing is broken.
#  (7) maxNameLen (24) must equal app/js/config.js's NAME_MAX_LEN. Hand-maintained in two
#      places because Gno cannot read that file at build time;
#      TestMaxNameLenMatchesTheAppsRule pins this side's value.
#  (8) RENAMING IS ALLOWED, NOT ONE-SHOT, and NAMES ARE UNIQUE across the collection. Both were
#      decided by the owner on 2026-10-16 before this file was written. Neither is a constant
#      that can be flipped -- they are the shape of SetName and of the nameOwner index -- so if
#      either is wrong, it is wrong before deploy, not after. Nothing on an immutable realm can
#      change them later.
#  (9) the invisible-letter denylist and the combining-mark exclusion are carried forward from
#      v4 verbatim. The combining-mark exclusion is a KNOWN, DOCUMENTED, STILL-OPEN product
#      question (realms/garden/NOTES.md, v4's finding Y7): it makes zalgo impossible and also
#      makes Devanagari, Thai and vocalised Hebrew/Arabic unspellable. v6 did not re-decide it.
#      Decide it before mainnet, not before onyx.
#
# MUST NOT use the arcade/... prefix (ARCADE.md 4.7, NOTES.md).
module = "gno.land/r/g1nq99m3h9ed7vqve6ajpr3qwy2ls252m8jnundm/garden/v6"
gno = "0.9"
